brew coffee.name: retrieve mug
brew coffee.definition: open the cupboard, reach inside, and pick up a mug

brew coffee.name: position mug
brew coffee.definition: place the mug under the nozzle of the coffee machine

brew coffee.name: turn on machine
brew coffee.definition: press the power button to switch on the coffee machine

brew coffee.name: prepare maker
brew coffee.definition: lift or flip parts of the coffee machine to ready it for brewing

prepare water tank.name: remove water tank
prepare water tank.definition: lift the lid and take the water tank off the coffee machine

prepare water tank.name: fill water tank
prepare water tank.definition: pour water from a filter jug into the water tank

prepare water tank.name: replace water tank
prepare water tank.definition: close the lid and put the filled water tank back onto the coffee machine base

load coffee capsule.name: retrieve capsule box
load coffee capsule.definition: take the box of coffee capsules from the shelf and open it

load coffee capsule.name: open machine compartment
load coffee capsule.definition: lift the handle to open the coffee machine capsule compartment

load coffee capsule.name: insert capsule
load coffee capsule.definition: take a coffee capsule from the box and slide it into the machine

load coffee capsule.name: lock compartment
load coffee capsule.definition: pull down the handle to lock the capsule in place and close the machine

froth milk.name: retrieve milk
froth milk.definition: open the fridge, take out the milk bottle, and close the fridge

froth milk.name: pour milk
froth milk.definition: open the milk bottle and pour milk into the milk frother

froth milk.name: setup frother
froth milk.definition: plug in the milk frother and turn on the power button

froth milk.name: prepare stirrer
froth milk.definition: open the stirrer box and pick a wooden stirrer

froth milk.name: start frothing
froth milk.definition: press the button on the coffee machine to begin frothing milk

mix milk and coffee.name: retrieve frother
mix milk and coffee.definition: pick up the milk frother from its base on the countertop

mix milk and coffee.name: pour milk into mug
mix milk and coffee.definition: tilt the milk frother to pour frothed milk into the coffee mug

mix milk and coffee.name: stir coffee
mix milk and coffee.definition: use a wooden stirrer to mix the coffee and frothed milk together

clean and tidy.name: rinse milk frother
clean and tidy.definition: take apart the milk frother and rinse it under the tap

clean and tidy.name: discard waste
clean and tidy.definition: throw used stirrers and expired items into the trash bin

clean and tidy.name: wipe and dry
clean and tidy.definition: use a sponge to clean up and dry hands with a towel
